Inference

Released Sep 5, 2025, 18 min

Play Inference on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

What does “inference” really mean in AI? In this video, we break down the concept step by step. We’ll define inference, contrast it with reasoning, and explore why it matters as a system-level property in artificial intelligence. Along the way, we’ll look at classic logic examples, blurred cases like diagnosis and translation, and practical tools for inference in knowledge graphs and ontologies.

What you’ll learn:

  • The difference between a sentence and a proposition
  • How inference works in logic and everyday AI tasks
  • Degrees of inference: strength, complexity, novelty
  • Why reasoning is not the same as inference
  • Real-world inference tools (SPARQL, reasoners, Python scripts)

Whether you’re new to AI concepts or diving deeper into ontologies and semantic web, this video gives you the foundation to understand what inference is—and why it’s central to AI.
